title: Bead Rollers & Beading Machines — Hydraulic, Motorized & Manual | NovoTech Canada
meta_description: İşitan bead rollers in Canada: hydraulic and motorized beading machines for sheet up to 8 ga, motorized bead rollers with pneumatic top shaft, manual bead rollers / swagers with cast-iron frames. Roll sets included, CSA panels, parts in Mississauga, ON.
intro: Bead rollers — also called beading machines, rotary machines or swagers — form stiffening beads, wired edges, flanges, crimps and seams in sheet metal for HVAC ducts, drums, tanks, buckets and architectural work. İşitan builds them from the IK hand-crank bead roller on a cast-iron frame to the HIBKS 4.0, whose hydraulic top roll beads 8 ga steel under constant pressure. Every machine comes with its sets of standard rolls; motorized models have a CSA-approved panel and all are supported from Mississauga, ON.

faq.q: Bead roller, beading machine, rotary machine or swager — what is the difference?
faq.a: They are the same machine under different names: two shaft-mounted rolls that form a profile in sheet metal as it is turned through them. "Bead roller" is the common North American term, "swager" the older sheet-metal trade word for the hand-crank version, "rotary machine" the HVAC term. The roll sets decide what it does — beading, wiring, crimping, flanging, burring or trimming.

Every İşitan bead roller ships with its standard roll sets — 4 sets (S1–S4) on the HIBKS / IBKS 4.0 and 2.5, 8 sets on the IKM 1.2, IKMP 1.2 and IK 1.2, 7 sets on the IK 0.8 and IKS 1.0 — plus the roll spanner key. Extra sets (E1–E8) and rolls for special jobs are made to order; tell us the profile you need.

On the IBKS the operator sets the gap between the rolls by hand and the motor turns them. On the HIBKS the top roll is moved hydraulically, so the pressure stays constant through the bead and deep beads in 8 ga steel are formed in one pass with the foot pedal — the choice for production work and heavier sheet.

The distance from the rolls to the frame: it sets how far from the sheet edge a bead can be formed. The IBKS 1.8 has an 11″ throat for beads deep into a panel; the HIBKS / IBKS 4.0 7.9″, the IKS 1.3 9.1″ and the small IK 0.8 3.1″.

faq.q: What voltage do bead rollers run on?
faq.a: Motorized models are supplied for 600 V 3-phase with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request and 240 V single-phase on the 1–2 HP models. The IK and IKS are hand-operated and need no power.
